verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents a Scheduled Task feature with its own usage docs page, and markets "Schedule tasks and let Agents handle the rest." It also describes agents scheduling and reporting "without staying online." The home dashboard shows what is still running and what agents did while you were away, which points to autonomous background execution. Missing for 10: the content of the scheduled-task docs (trigger types, recurrence, configuration depth) is not in the pack, event-based triggers are undocumented, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that background automations run reliably.
